title: 36 Hours in Valencia, Spain
abstract: Long famous as the birthplace of paella, Valencia offers 300 days of sunshine, exuberant architecture and wide swaths of urban green spaces. And with artists, designers and digital nomads moving in, its cultural scene and gastronomy are soaring.

title: 36 Hours in Singapore
abstract: The former British colony is celebrating its diamond jubilee this year, and there’s every reason to plan a visit: hike through a beautiful rainforest, visit a supercool art and science museum, and sample the food. Oh, the food!

title: 36 Hours in Hilo, Hawaii
abstract: Low key and affordable, Hilo has recently raised its coolness factor with a swanky new speakeasy and local chefs gaining national recognition. And outside town, you can witness the fiery spectacle of its resident volcano, Kilauea, now in a particularly active phase.

title: 36 Hours in Budapest
abstract: New museums, galleries and spruced-up parks counterbalance this Central European city’s classic architecture and thermal baths.
